description: Moyens de production électrique is a dataset listed in data.gouv.nc open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Les données relatives aux moyens de production électrique proviennent des dossiers transmis par les porteurs de projet à la DIMENC dans le cadre des demandes d'autorisation d'exploiter instruits. Généalogie: Mise à jour le 18 mai 2018. Coverage: New Caledonia. The portal files it under Territory Development, Infrastructure, Territory, Economy, Employment. Its keywords are energies, moyens de production electriques, electricites, centrales thermiques, centrales hydroelectriquesrmes eoliennes, centrales photovoltaiques. The portal shows 2018-07-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gouv-nc-portal.
